table.name: admin_table_comments
table.viewSql: SELECT c.table_schema, c.table_name, CASE WHEN (( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_tables i WHERE ((i.schemaname = (c.table_schema)::name) AND (i.tablename = (c.table_name)::name))) = 0) THEN 'VIEW'::text ELSE 'TABLE'::text END AS table_view, d.description FROM (((information_schema.tables c JOIN pg_class c1 ON (((c.table_name)::name = c1.relname))) JOIN pg_namespace n ON ((((c.table_schema)::name = n.nspname) AND (c1.relnamespace = n.oid)))) LEFT JOIN pg_description d ON ((d.objoid = c1.oid))) WHERE ((c.table_schema)::name = 'verundentsorgung'::name) ORDER BY c.table_schema, c.table_name, CASE WHEN (( SELECT count(*) AS count FROM pg_tables i WHERE ((i.schemaname = (c.table_schema)::name) AND (i.tablename = (c.table_name)::name))) = 0) THEN 'VIEW'::text ELSE 'TABLE'::text END; SELECT d.table_schema, d.table_name, d.table_view, d.description, wsd.aliasname AS websuite_aliasname, wsd.teaser AS websuite_teaser, wsd.sichtbarkeit AS websuite_sichtbarkeit, wsd.editierbarkeit AS websuite_editierbarkeit, wsd.load_all AS websuite_load_all FROM (( SELECT t.table_schema, t.table_name, replace((t.table_type)::text, 'BASE TABLE'::text, 'TABLE'::text) AS table_view, obj_description(pgc.oid, 'pg_class'::name) AS description FROM ((information_schema.tables t JOIN pg_class pgc ON (((t.table_name)::name = pgc.relname))) JOIN pg_namespace pgn ON (((pgn.oid = pgc.relnamespace) AND (pgn.nspname = (t.table_schema)::name)))) WHERE (((t.table_schema)::name = 'verundentsorgung'::name) AND ((t.table_type)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('BASE TABLE'::character varying)::text, ('VIEW'::character varying)::text])) AND (pgc.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char"])))) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT admin_table_dictionary.id, admin_table_dictionary.angelegt_am, admin_table_dictionary.bemerkung, admin_table_dictionary.aliasname, admin_table_dictionary.teaser, admin_table_dictionary.sichtbarkeit, admin_table_dictionary.table_catalog, admin_table_dictionary.table_schema, admin_table_dictionary.table_name, admin_table_dictionary.table_type, admin_table_dictionary.gueltig_von, admin_table_dictionary.gueltig_bis, admin_table_dictionary.editierbarkeit, admin_table_dictionary.real_table_name, admin_table_dictionary.load_all FROM admin.admin_table_dictionary WHERE ((admin_table_dictionary.table_schema)::text ~~ 'verundentsorgung_viewer_zvg'::text)) wsd ON (((d.table_name)::text = (wsd.table_name)::text))) ORDER BY d.table_schema, d.table_name;

eig.kurztext AS eigentuemer_kurztext, eig.langtext AS eigentuemer_langtext, betr.kurztext AS betreiber_kurztext, betr.langtext AS betreiber_langtext FROM med ON ((b.id_st_vw_medium = med.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_lagestatus ls ON ((b.id_st_vw_lagestatus = ls.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_versiegelung v ON ((b.id_st_vw_versiegelung = v.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_abrechnung a ON ((b.id_st_vw_abrechnung = a.id))) WHERE (b.gueltig_bis > now());

table.name: strassenschluessel_v
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id_strasse, a.strasse, a.zuordnung, a.gueltig_von_strasse, a.gueltig_bis_strasse, a.id_amt, a.amt, a.gueltig_von_amt, a.gueltig_bis_amt, a.id_gemeinde, a.gemeinde, a.alkis_gemshl, a.gueltig_von_gemeinde, a.gueltig_bis_gemeinde, a.id_ort, a.ort, a.gueltig_von_ort, a.gueltig_bis_ort, a.id_widmung, a.widmung, a.gueltig_von_widmung, a.gueltig_bis_widmung, a.id, a.zuordnung AS id_suche, a.bewertungsstichtag_gemeinde, a.alkis_strshl FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.id AS id_strasse, s.strasse, (((((s.strasse)::text || ', Ort: '::text) || (o.ort)::text) || ', Gemeinde: '::text) || (g.gemeinde)::text) AS zuordnung, s.gueltig_von AS gueltig_von_strasse, s.gueltig_bis AS gueltig_bis_strasse, a_1.id AS id_amt, a_1.amt, a_1.gueltig_von AS gueltig_von_amt, a_1.gueltig_bis AS gueltig_bis_amt, g.id AS id_gemeinde, g.gemeinde, g.alkis_gemshl, g.gueltig_von AS gueltig_von_gemeinde, g.gueltig_bis AS gueltig_bis_gemeinde, o.id AS id_ort, o.ort, o.gueltig_von AS gueltig_von_ort, o.gueltig_bis AS gueltig_bis_ort, w.id AS id_widmung, w.langtext AS widmung, w.gueltig_von AS gueltig_von_widmung, w.gueltig_bis AS gueltig_bis_widmung, g.bewertungsstichtag AS bewertungsstichtag_gemeinde, s.alkis_strshl FROM infrastruktur.amt a_1, infrastruktur.gemeinde g, infrastruktur.ort o, infrastruktur.vw_widmung w, infrastruktur.strasse s WHERE (((a_1.id)::text = (g.id_amt)::text) AND ((g.id)::text = (o.id_gemeinde)::text) AND ((o.id)::text = (s.id_ort)::text) AND ((w.id)::text = (s.id_widmung)::text) AND (a_1.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (g.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (o.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (w.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (s.gueltig_bis > now()) AND ((1 = 1) OR ((s.strasse)::text <> '-'::text)) AND ((1 = 1) OR ((a_1.amt)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('Amt Schönberger Land'::character varying)::text, ('Amt Klützer Winkel'::character varying)::text, ('Stadt Grevesmühlen'::character varying)::text, ('Amt Grevesmühlen Land'::character varying)::text]))))) a; SELECT a.id_st_strasse, a.strasse, a.zuordnung, a.gueltig_von_strasse, a.gueltig_bis_strasse, a.id_st_amt, a.amt, a.gueltig_von_amt, a.gueltig_bis_amt, a.id_st_gemeinde, a.gemeinde, a.alkis_gemshl, a.gueltig_von_gemeinde, a.gueltig_bis_gemeinde, a.id_st_ort, a.ort, a.gueltig_von_ort, a.gueltig_bis_ort, a.id, a.zuordnung AS id_suche, a.id_st_vw_projekt, a.projekt_kurztext, a.projekt_langtext FROM ( SELECT s.id, s.id AS id_st_strasse, s.strasse, ((((s.strasse || ', Ort: '::text) || o.ort) || ', Gemeinde: '::text) || g.gemeinde) AS zuordnung, (s.gueltig_von)::text AS gueltig_von_strasse, (s.gueltig_bis)::text AS gueltig_bis_strasse, a_1.id AS id_st_amt, a_1.amt, (a_1.gueltig_von)::text AS gueltig_von_amt, (a_1.gueltig_bis)::text AS gueltig_bis_amt, g.id AS id_st_gemeinde, g.gemeinde, g.alkis_gemshl, (g.gueltig_von)::text AS gueltig_von_gemeinde, (g.gueltig_bis)::text AS gueltig_bis_gemeinde, o.id AS id_st_ort, o.ort, (o.gueltig_von)::text AS gueltig_von_ort, (o.gueltig_bis)::text AS gueltig_bis_ort, p.id AS id_st_vw_projekt, p.kurztext AS projekt_kurztext, p.langtext AS projekt_langtext FROM verundentsorgung.st_amt a_1, verundentsorgung.st_gemeinde g, verundentsorgung.st_ort o, verundentsorgung.st_strasse s, verundentsorgung.st_vw_projekt p WHERE ((a_1.id_st_vw_projekt = p.id) AND (g.id_st_vw_projekt = p.id) AND (o.id_st_vw_projekt = p.id) AND (s.id_st_vw_projekt = p.id) AND (a_1.id = g.id_st_amt) AND (g.id = o.id_st_gemeinde) AND (o.id = s.id_st_ort) AND (a_1.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (g.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (o.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (s.gueltig_bis > now()) AND (p.gueltig_bis > now()) AND ((1 = 1) OR (s.strasse <> '-'::text)) AND ((1 = 1) OR (a_1.amt = ANY (ARRAY['Amt Schönberger Land'::text, 'Amt Klützer Winkel'::text, 'Stadt Grevesmühlen'::text, 'Amt Grevesmühlen Land'::text]))))) a; SELECT s.id, a.amt, g.gemeinde, o.ort, s.strasse FROM verundentsorgung_oracle.amt a, verundentsorgung_oracle.gemeinde g, verundentsorgung_oracle.ort o, verundentsorgung_oracle.strasse s WHERE ((a.id = g.id_amt_schluessel) AND (g.id = o.id_gemeinde_schluessel) AND (o.id = s.id_ort_schluessel)); SELECT s.id, a.amt, g.gemeinde, o.ort, s.strasse FROM verundentsorgung_oracle_zkwal.amt a, verundentsorgung_oracle_zkwal.gemeinde g, verundentsorgung_oracle_zkwal.ort o, verundentsorgung_oracle_zkwal.strasse s WHERE ((a.id = g.id_amt_schluessel) AND (g.id = o.id_gemeinde_schluessel) AND (o.id = s.id_ort_schluessel));

s.gemeinde, s.ort, s.strasse, p.kurztext AS projekt_kurztext, p.langtext AS projekt_langtext, bs.kurztext AS betriebsstatus_kurztext, bs.langtext AS betriebsstatus_langtext, eig.kurztext AS eigentuemer_kurztext, eig.langtext AS eigentuemer_langtext, betr.kurztext AS betreiber_kurztext, betr.langtext AS betreiber_langtext, mat.kurztext AS material_kurztext, mat.langtext AS material_langtext, med.kurztext AS medium_kurztext, med.langtext AS medium_langtext, ls.kurztext AS lagestatus_kurztext, ls.langtext AS lagestatus_langtext, (b.baujahr)::text AS baujahr, b.orientation, b.layout FROM (((((((((verundentsorgung.wa_pkt_topologie_default b LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.strassenschluessel_v s ON ((b.id_st_strasse = s.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_projekt p ON ((b.id_st_vw_projekt = p.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_betriebsstatus bs ON ((b.id_st_vw_betriebsstatus = bs.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_eigentuemer eig ON ((b.id_st_vw_eigentuemer = eig.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_betreiber betr ON ((b.id_st_vw_betreiber = betr.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_material mat ON ((b.id_st_vw_material = mat.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_medium med ON ((b.id_st_vw_medium = med.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_lagestatus ls ON ((b.id_st_vw_lagestatus = ls.id))) LEFT JOIN verundentsorgung.st_vw_topologie topo ON ((b.id_st_vw_topologie = topo.id))) WHERE (b.gueltig_bis > now());
